environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. ALB has a single HTTPS listener forwarding to target group on port 8080. No additional AWS WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs as a systemd service with Python 3.9 and Flask 2.3. SQLite database is stored locally at /var/lib/app/users.db with read-write permissions for the app user.

config.alb_rules: default action forward to target group
